title: GameType
description: A game type defines the rules and mechanics for setting up a game server

runtime.description: The runtime environment for the game server, used for determining how to start the server and manage its process

args.description: A list of command line arguments to pass to the game server process when starting it

arg.description: The command line argument to pass to the game server process, can include placeholders for user configuration options in the format {configOptionName}

config.description: Defines how the argument can be configured by the user in the UI

icon.description: A URL to an icon representing the game

developerIcon.description: A URL to an icon representing the developer

variants.description: A list of game variants, which are different configurations of the game

icon.description: A URL to an icon representing the variant

configurations.description: A list of user configurable options for the game type

filePath.description: The file path to the configuration file, relative to the instance's directory

lines.description: A list of lines in the configuration file that can be modified by the user

name.description: The name of the configuration option

desc.description: A description of the configuration option

category.description: The category of the configuration option, used for grouping related options together in the UI

linePrefix.description: A string that appears before the value in the configuration file, used for parsing the file and updating the value

valueType.description: The type of the value, used for validating user input and displaying the appropriate UI element for editing the value

enumOptions.description: A list of valid options for the configuration option, used for validating user input and displaying a dropdown menu for editing the value when valueType is 'enum'

default.description: The default value for the configuration option, used for resetting to defaults and file generation

config.description: Defines how the configuration option can be configured by the user in the UI

supportedPlatforms.description: The platforms this game server can run on. Uses Node.js process.platform values.

modProviders.description: A list of mod providers that can be used to install mods for this game

name.description: The name of the mod provider

desc.description: A description of the mod provider

icon.description: A URL to an icon representing the mod provider

imageUrl.description: A URL to an image file

userConfig.description: Defines where user options are stored and used for a game type

configType.description: The type of user configuration, used for displaying the appropriate UI for editing user options

default.description: The default value for the user configuration option, used for resetting to defaults and file generation
